note: Read-only. Covers the already-merged live-room go-live notification fix of #4539 (commit 6028392a, services/gateway/src/routes/live.ts notifyRoomWentLive). The notifications are writes to production data and cannot run on staging (rule 48), so the proof of the behaviour is the jest suite below; the HTTP checks only prove the live router carrying the change loaded and its auth gate still rejects before the handler. Nothing targets production.

tests.name: gateway alive after deploy
tests.reason: read-only GET: the build carrying the live.ts change boots and serves

tests.name: live router health serves
tests.reason: read-only GET of the public live health route (live.ts GET /health, mounted at /api/v1/live): proves the live router carrying #4539 loaded on the deployed commit

tests.name: enter rejects an invalid bearer before the handler
tests.reason: rejected probe: requireAuth on POST /rooms/:id/enter refuses an invalid bearer before the handler that now calls notifyRoomWentLive runs

Write-path proof of #4539: a scheduled session create sends no go-live push, a live/lobby create and a successful host start via /enter notify followers and Notify-me subscribers (never the host), a refused host start and a viewer entry send none; plus the existing live enter/exit suite.
